segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good morning, you are through to the broadband support team. My name is Sarah. How can I help?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Sarah. My internet keeps dropping out every evening, usually around seven o'clock.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me which lights are showing on your router right now?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The power light is green, but the internet light is flashing orange.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thanks. That usually means the line is out of sync. I will run a quick test from our side.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The test found some noise on the line. I can book an engineer for Thursday morning. Does that work for you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thursday morning is perfect. Thank you very much.
